def fit(f,p0,name):
    best=None
    for s in range(6):
        x0=np.array(p0)*(1+0.3*np.random.randn(len(p0))) if s else np.array(p0,float)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-dP_dt, x0, max_nfev=3000)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception: pass
    nmse=np.mean((f(best.x)-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
    print(name, '%.3e'%nmse, best.x.round(4))
